work: Two things I follow closely: space launches and missions -- rocket launches, NASA and private space company news, satellite deployments -- and personal finance and investing -- markets, interest rates, saving and investing tips for regular people, economic policy that affects household budgets.
fun: Video game industry news -- new game releases, studio and publisher news, esports results. Separately, tabletop and board games -- new releases, designer interviews, board game conventions; these are two different hobbies for me, don't lump them together. Also home renovation and DIY projects -- home improvement trends, tools, renovation stories.
avoid: Climate change and climate policy -- I get enough of it elsewhere and don't want it in this podcast.
depth: Deep analysis on personal finance, since it affects real decisions I make. Headlines only for space launches, video games, board games, and home renovation.
